units.summary: New test that passes unsorted, duplicated refs to CompactSelectedSeries. It checks that compaction succeeds, all three series are evicted and only one block is written. It covers the sort/compact normalization in CompactSelectedSeries.
units.headline: New test for unsorted, duplicate refs in CompactSelectedSeries
units.reason: New test only; it cannot affect production behavior.

units.summary: The exported type StaleHead is renamed to SelectedSeriesHead, and its field is now the generic seriesRefs type. External code using tsdb.StaleHead (for example Mimir) will stop compiling.
units.headline: Exported StaleHead renamed to SelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Renaming an exported type breaks the public Go API for downstream consumers.

units.summary: The exported constructor NewStaleHead is renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead and now takes seriesRefs. The body is unchanged apart from the field name.
units.headline: NewStaleHead renamed to NewSelectedSeriesHead
units.reason: Removing an exported constructor is a public API break.
focus: External callers of NewStaleHead now fail to compile

units.summary: Index now delegates to head.selectedSeriesIndex instead of staleIndex. That function is a renamed or generalized version of the stale index reader, defined in another unit.
units.headline: Index delegates to selectedSeriesIndex instead of staleIndex
units.reason: Simple delegation; any logic change lives in selectedSeriesIndex, which is another unit.

units.summary: NumSeries now returns the number of selected refs instead of the head-wide NumStaleSeries counter. For selected-series compaction this is the correct count, and it feeds into the block's Meta stats. For the stale path it now counts only stale series without OOO data, not every stale series.
units.headline: NumSeries counts selected refs instead of head stale-series counter
units.reason: Changes the value reported in block meta stats for both the stale and selected compaction paths.
focus: Whether anything in compactor.Write relies on Meta().Stats.NumSeries
The count spans all chunk ranges, not one slice; check this is acceptable

units.summary: The placeholder ULID used for the view's Meta changes from STALEHEAD to SELECTEDSERIES. It identifies the in-memory view only.
units.headline: Placeholder ULID for the head view renamed
units.reason: Placeholder ID for an in-memory view; low risk unless something matches on the old value.

units.summary: Meta now uses the renamed receiver and the new placeholder ULID. Otherwise the structure is unchanged.
units.headline: Meta uses renamed type and new placeholder ULID
units.reason: Mechanical rename; the stats change comes from NumSeries, which is reviewed separately.

units.summary: The String output changes from 'stale head' to 'selected-series head', and a doc typo is fixed. It only affects log and error text.
units.headline: String text now says 'selected-series head'
units.reason: Only log and error text changes.
